title: Diving Atlantis school in Los Cristianos
description:
Discover Tenerife's underwater world with the Atlantis diving school in Los Cristianos. Their multilingual instructors take you to the island's most interesting dive sites, both from the boat and the shore.

Whether it's your very first time underwater or you're an experienced diver, the team tailors the dive to you — calm, clear, warm Atlantic water full of marine life. No experience is needed for a first try-dive; certified divers can explore deeper sites.

A memorable experience for ages 8 and up. All equipment is provided — just bring a swimsuit and a towel.

title: Helicopter Tours — Helidream
description:
See Tenerife the way few people ever do — from a helicopter. Helidream flights take off from the Adeje Heliport on the south-west coast, lifting you over the island's dramatic coastline, cliffs and volcanic interior.

Depending on the route, you'll soar over the Costa Adeje resorts, the towering Los Gigantes cliffs and the slopes climbing toward Teide, with nothing between you and the view. Flights run daily, subject to weather and schedule.

An unforgettable bucket-list experience and a stunning way to mark a special occasion. Bring a camera — the photos are extraordinary.

title: Parascending attraction in Puerto Colon
description:
Float high above the Atlantic on a parascending flight from Puerto Colón — a calm, breathtaking ride suitable for all ages. You're strapped safely into the harness and parachute, towed gently up behind the boat, then left to relax and soak up the views.

Fun, gentle and safe — great for couples, families and anyone who wants the views without the adrenaline overload.

title: La Gomera island — 1 day bus Tour + ferry
description:

A full day out, so bring a light jacket for the cooler, misty highlands and comfortable walking shoes.

title: Aqualand — waterpark in Costa Adeje
description:
Aqualand Costa Adeje is the island's biggest water park — and the only one with its own dolphinarium. Right in the heart of Costa Adeje, it's a full day of splashing for every age and every nerve level.

Thrill-seekers head for the high-speed slides — the Tornado, the Kamikazes and the newer Cyclones, plus Tsunami, rapids and a giant wave pool. Younger kids get their own worlds in Kidzworld, Forestland and Dragonland, with gentle slides and shallow pools. When you need a breather, drift down the Lava River or sink into a jacuzzi bed in the open-air spa.

The park is also known for its daily dolphin show in a dedicated arena. Plan a full day, bring towels and sunscreen, and arrive early to beat the queues on the big rides.

title: Jungle Park — ZOO oriented to jungle animals
description:
Jungle Park (formerly Parque Las Águilas) is a lush 75,000 m² zoo and botanical park just 15 minutes from Los Cristianos, home to more than 500 animals roaming among waterfalls, lagoons, caves and jungle suspension bridges.

Two shows anchor the day: the spectacular Birds of Prey flight, where eagles, falcons and vultures swoop low over the audience, and the ever-popular Sea Lion show. Along the trails you'll meet orangutans, gibbons, penguins, crocodiles, meerkats, flamingos, macaws and much more. For one last thrill, ride BOB — an 800-metre toboggan run down through the park.

Great for families and animal lovers. Allow at least half a day and check the show times on arrival so you don't miss them.

title: Loro Parque tickets — The biggest ZOO in Tenerife
description:
Loro Parque in Puerto de la Cruz is far more than a zoo — it's an internationally recognised animal conservation park, home to over 400 species across 135,000 m² of subtropical gardens.

The day is built around its world-class habitats and presentations: orcas in the vast Orca Ocean pools, bottlenose dolphins in one of the most modern dolphinariums in the world, a colony of penguins living in a real-snow Antarctic enclosure, and the largest parrot collection on earth — the park's namesake and conservation flagship.

Between shows you can walk the aquarium shark tunnel, visit the gorilla and chimpanzee habitats and wander the themed gardens. Plan a full day to catch the main presentations without rushing — they run on a timed schedule throughout the day.

title: Siam Park — Tickets to the legendary water park
description:
Siam Park isn't just a water park — it's the one TripAdvisor has crowned the best on the planet for seven years running, and the moment you walk through the gates you'll understand why.

The headline ride, Tower of Power, drops you almost vertically down a 28-metre slide at speeds touching 80 km/h, straight through a transparent tunnel inside a shark and ray tank. Prefer to take it slow? Drift the length of the one-kilometre Mai Thai River through lush Thai-themed jungle, or ride the Wave Palace, home to some of the largest artificial waves in the world.

With more than a dozen attractions, a white-sand beach, dedicated kids' areas and Thai-styled restaurants across the park, it's an easy full day out for families, couples and thrill-seekers alike. Tip: arrive early — the big rides build queues by midday.
